nodes.description: owner: privileged address set to msg.sender in constructor, gates delegate/batchSend/init/setTradeAddress and is whitelisted in ensure().
balanceOf: public balance mapping mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom/batchSend and initialised in constructor.
allowance: public nested allowance mapping mutated unchecked in transferFrom and approve; constructor grants infinite allowance to UNI router.
totalSupply: total token supply, minted in constructor with an unchecked multiplication.
name: token name set in constructor.
symbol: token symbol set in constructor.
decimals: constant 18 used as scaling exponent in init() and constructor.
UNI: constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure().
_onSaleNum: per-address sale counter incremented unchecked in transferFrom and read in condition().
canSale: per-address whitelist mapping that bypasses transfer conditions in ensure().
_minSale: minimum transfer amount threshold configured in init().
_maxSale: maximum transfer amount threshold configured in init().
_saleNum: maximum number of sales per address configured in init().
tradeAddress: mutable whitelisted address set by setTradeAddress() and trusted in ensure().
transfer(address,uint): public payable entrypoint that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
ensure(address,address,uint): internal whitelist/sale-condition gate controlling who may transfer tokens.
transferFrom(address,address,uint): public payable transfer with unchecked allowance/balance mutations and sale counter increment.
approve(address,uint): public payable allowance setter writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition(address,uint): internal view enforcing _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale sale restrictions.
delegate(address,bytes): owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into attacker-supplied address and calldata.
init(uint,uint,uint): owner-only configuration of sale limits using unchecked multiplications.
batchSend(address[],uint): owner-only mass transfer with unchecked multiplication, subtraction and loop accounting.
setTradeAddress(address): owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist used by ensure().
pairFor(address,address,address): pure Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure().
constructor(string,string,uint): payable constructor minting supply with unchecked multiplication, setting owner and infinite router allowance.
msg.sender: caller identity used for privileged checks, allowance spending and owner assignment.
a.delegatecall(b): executes arbitrary untrusted bytecode in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value and _onSaleNum[_from]++ without SafeMath.
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total plus loop accumulation of balances.
Unchecked token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) multiplications in init().
Unchecked _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) multiplication and uint(-1) allowance grant in constructor.
ensure(): owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist silently bypasses the sale-condition gate, restricting ordinary holders.
_from parameter of transferFrom.
_to parameter of transferFrom.
_value parameter of transferFrom.
_from parameter of ensure.
_to parameter of ensure.
_value parameter of ensure.
a: attacker-controlled delegatecall target in delegate.
b: attacker-controlled delegatecall calldata in delegate.
_tos: recipient array of batchSend.
_value: per-recipient amount of batchSend.
saleNum: per-address sale limit set in init.
token: minimum sale amount scaling input of init.
maxToken: maximum sale amount scaling input of init.
addr: new whitelisted trade address in setTradeAddress.
_UNI: locally computed Uniswap pair address compared in ensure's whitelist.
total: batchSend product _value * _tos.length.
_to: per-iteration recipient in batchSend loop.
i: batchSend loop counter.
